caption: The image shows a single ornate teapot placed against a plain background. The teapot has a rectangular body with rounded edges, a wide curved spout on the right, and a large, elaborate handle on the left. The lid is topped with a small knob and is decorated with a floral motif. The surface of the teapot is covered with detailed, intricate patterns and scenes, including depictions of horses and figures in front of a large building with columns, as well as sailing ships and floral patterns surrounding the scene. The overall color of the teapot is dark with lighter areas highlighting the designs, giving it a two-tone appearance in sepia or brownish hues. The image has a monochromatic color scheme, and the lighting creates slight shadows under and around the teapot. The composition centers the teapot within the frame, with no additional objects visible.
title: Teapot - "Mt. Vernon"
